title: Settings › search finds a setting and shows it
steps: Open Settings and type "dark" in the search field above the pages (or press ⌘F)
Use ↓ to move to Theme when dark and press Return
Search "hotkey", then "traces", and click each result
Press Esc in the search field
expected: Results list each setting with its page and section, best match first. Opening one shows its page (and its tab on AI or Importance & labels), scrolls to the row and highlights it briefly. Nothing matching says so. Esc clears the search and the page list comes back.
